title: When can we meet?
instructions: İki iş arkadaşı toplantı için uygun bir zaman arıyor. Kimin ne zaman müsait olduğuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Rob, we need to meet about the new project. Are you free on Monday?

script.speaker: rob
script.text: Monday's difficult. I'm at a conference all day.

script.speaker: rob
script.text: I'm free after eleven. Before that, I've got a meeting with a client.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: I have lunch with my manager at twelve. So eleven to twelve?

script.speaker: rob
script.text: Perfect. Shall we meet in my office?

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Let's use meeting room three. Your office is very small!

script.speaker: rob
script.text: Ha! True. See you on Tuesday.

questions.prompt: Why can't Rob meet on Monday?
options: He has lunch with a client.
questions.evidence: I'm at a conference all day.

questions.prompt: What is Rob doing on Tuesday before eleven?
questions.feedback: On birden önce bir müşteriyle toplantısı var.
questions.evidence: I've got a meeting with a client.

questions.feedback: On birden on ikiye; on ikide Anna'nın öğle yemeği var.
Rob'un ofisi küçük; üç numaralı toplantı odasını kullanacaklar.
